page.layout: Two printed columns on one page. Left column: a centred letter heading (אח) above a list of Hebrew entries. Right column: continuing entries. A catchword sits at the lower right below the last line. No marginal notes. Page number and running heads at the top.

main_text.head: אח
main_text.l: אֶחְבָּא abscondam me, fut. Niph. 1. sing. R. חָבָא.
אַחְבָּא occultabo, fut. Hiph. 1. sing. R. חָבָא.
אָחָה ulva, gramen, No. sing. masc. Rad. אָח.
אֲחָוָה fraternitas, No. sing. fæm. à f. m. אָח frater, Rad. inusit. אָחָה.
אֲחוּדָה proponam ænigma, 1. sing. fut. Kal, & parag. Rad. חוּר.
אֲחַוֶּה indicabo, אֲחַוְךָ indicabo tibi, 1. sing. fut. Piel, aff. Rad. חָוָה.
אֲחֻם parcam, 1. sing. fut. Kal, Rad. חוּם.
אֲחוֹת, אֲחוֹת soror, No. f. fæm. אֲחָיוֹת, אֲחָיוֹת sorores, pl. fæm. à No. f. m. אָח frater, Rad. אָחָה.
אָחוֹר retrorsum, אֲחוֹרִי posteriora mea, &c. No. sing. & pl. m. aff. Rad. אַחַר post, postea,
אֲחוֹתִי indicatio mea, sing. fæm. aff. No. אֲחָוָה indicatio, Rad. חָוָה indicavit.
אָח, constr. אֲחִי frater, אָחִיו frater ejus, אַחִים, אֲחֵי fratres, אֲחֵיהֶם fratres ejus, &c. No. sing. & pl. masc. affix. Rad. אָחָה.
וָאֶחֱזֶה & comprehendi, אֲחֻזָּה prehendam, &c. 1. sing. fut. Kal, Rad. אָחַז.
אֶחֱזֶה videbo, Job. 23. 9. fut. Kal, 1. sing. apocop. pro אֶחֱזֶה; Rad. חָזָה.
אֲחֻזַּתְכֶם possessio vestra, אֲחֻזַּתָּם possessio ipsorum, sing. fæm. constr. aff. No. אֲחֻזָּה; R. אָחַז.
אֶחְטֶנָּה expiabo illud, fut. Piel, 1. sing. אַחְטָא aff. Rad. חָטָא.
אֲחוּלָה exspectabo, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. parag. Rad. יָחַל.
